breadcrumb.label: The library these settings belong to

identity.name: Name
identity.colourReaches: The colour appears in the sidebar straight away.

missing.title: This library is not here
missing.body: It may have been deleted, or it may never have been yours. This instance does not say which.

categories.title: Categories
categories.first: No categories yet. The first one goes here.
categories.deleteBody_zero: Nothing is in it. Deleting a category never deletes recordings.
categories.deleteBody_one: {{count}} recording loses its category. It is not deleted.
categories.deleteBody_other: {{count}} recordings lose their category. They are not deleted.
categories.deleteWithChildren_zero: Its {{children}} sub-categories go with it. Nothing is in them, and deleting a category never deletes recordings.
categories.deleteWithChildren_one: Its {{children}} sub-categories go with it, and {{count}} recording loses its category. No recording is deleted.
categories.deleteWithChildren_other: Its {{children}} sub-categories go with it, and {{count}} recordings lose their category. No recording is deleted.

shares.title: Who has access
shares.none: Only you can see this library.
shares.revokeBody_one: {{name}} loses access to the {{count}} recording in {{library}}.
shares.revokeBody_other: {{name}} loses access to all {{count}} recordings in {{library}}.
shares.throughThisLibrary: Access through this library. A recording moved here from somewhere else can carry access of its own, which is shown on the recording.
shares.personal: Your personal library cannot be shared. It is where a recording goes when nobody chose, so it stays yours.
shares.readOnly: You can add to this library but not share it onwards. Only somebody who can manage it can change who has access.

add.title: Give somebody access
add.notADirectory: The whole address, exactly. Sonarium does not search for people, and will not tell you who else has an account here.
add.nobody: No account here has that address.
add.already: {{name}} already has access. Change their level above.
add.whatTheyCanDo: What they will be able to do

trash.action: Move this library to the trash
trash.title: Move {{name}} to the trash?
trash.window_one: You can put it back for {{count}} day.
trash.window_other: You can put it back for {{count}} days.
